definition_zh: 用头（角）顶撞；烟蒂；枪托；酒桶；屁股（口语）
definition_en: to strike with the head or horns; also the end of a cigarette, the stock end of a gun, a large barrel, or (informal) the bottom
core_image: 公羊低头一顶，把对手撞出老远
scene: 山坡上两只公羊低着头冲向对方。The young ram learned to butt his rival off the ledge.
sceneCN: 这里 butt 是「用头顶撞」（第 1 个义项：以头或角冲撞）；句意是这只小公羊学会了用头把对手顶下石台。

pos.zh: 烟蒂；枪托；酒桶；（口语）屁股

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 转名词，义为「顶撞行为」
由拉丁前缀加同源词根构成，义为「毗邻，紧靠」

senses.title: To strike with the head or horns
senses.definition: to hit someone or something with the head or horns, pushing forward
senses.definitionCN: 用头或角向前冲撞某人或某物
senses.example: Goats butt each other to decide who leads the herd.
senses.exampleCN: 山羊互相顶撞，决出谁是头羊。
senses.why: The image is a lowered head driven forward like a blow.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是低头向前一顶，像一次打击。

senses.title: The thick end of a tool or cigarette
senses.definition: the larger or thicker end of something, especially the leftover stub of a smoked cigarette or the stock end of a gun
senses.definitionCN: 器物较粗的一端，尤指抽剩的烟蒂或枪的托端
senses.example: He crushed the butt under his boot.
senses.why: The same word names the thick end that absorbs the blow, like the animal's head.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也指承受冲撞的粗端，正如顶撞用的头部。

senses.title: A large cask for wine or water
senses.definition: a large barrel or cask, especially for wine, beer or rainwater
senses.definitionCN: 大桶，多用于盛酒、啤酒或雨水
senses.example: A rain butt stood under the cottage eaves.
senses.exampleCN: 农舍屋檐下放着一只接雨水的大桶。
senses.why: A separate old French word for a cask happened to match this form.
senses.whyCN: 这是古法语另一支「大桶」一词的巧合同形，与顶撞义并不同源。

senses.title: A person or thing that is mocked
senses.definition: a person or thing at whom mockery or criticism is directed
senses.definitionCN: 成为嘲笑或批评目标的人或事物
senses.example: The clumsy apprentice was the butt of every joke in the workshop.
senses.exampleCN: 这个笨手笨脚的学徒成了作坊里所有笑话的靶子。
senses.why: The target of blows becomes the target of laughter.
senses.whyCN: 承受撞击的「靶」转为承受笑声的「靶」。

senses.title: The bottom (informal)
senses.definition: informal word for the part of the body one sits on
senses.definitionCN: 口语中指坐着的身体部位
senses.example: Get off your butt and help us move the table.
senses.exampleCN: 别闲坐着了，过来帮我们搬桌子。
senses.why: The thick-end sense slid to the rounded end of the body.
senses.whyCN: 「粗端」义滑移到身体浑圆的末端。

intro.en: Butt is really two or three words that look alike: a butting head from French boter, a cask from Old French butt, and a thick end from the same Germanic root as button.
intro.cn: butt 实为几个同形词：顶撞义出自法语 boter，大桶义出自古法语 butt，粗端义则与 button 同一日耳曼词根。

items.en: a Germanic root for 'to strike, push' gave Old French boter and English beat-adjacent forms.
items.cn: 日耳曼词根表示「击打、推撞」，进入古法语 boter，与英语 beat 相邻。

items.en: boter meant to push or strike; butt entered English in the sense of thrusting with the head.
items.cn: 古法语 boter 意为推撞；butt 进入英语时即指用头顶撞。

items.en: a separate Old French butt meant a cask, from Late Latin buttis.
items.cn: 古法语另一词 butt 指大桶，出自后期拉丁语 buttis。

items.en: the thick-end sense grew through archery butts and the end of a tool, later the cigarette butt.
items.cn: 十四至十六世纪，「粗端」义经射箭靶座、工具末端发展，后指烟蒂。

items.en: informal use for the bottom is American, and butt in is the common idiom for interrupting.
items.cn: 现代英语中，「屁股」义为美式口语，butt in 则是「插嘴」的常用习语。

note.en: The look-alike group collects same-form words of different origins; the near-meaning group gives striking and stub words.
note.cn: 形近组收集同形异源词；近义组是冲撞与「剩余短端」词汇。

entries.definition: to border on, touch at an end
entries.definitionCN: 毗邻，端部相接，同源动词
孤峰平顶山，只是拼写相近，词源无关
纽扣，与「粗端」义同出日耳曼词根
扶壁，同出「推撞」词根的支撑义

entries.definition: to strike or force by driving
the short leftover end, as of a pencil or cigarette
entries.definitionCN: 残余短端，如铅笔头、烟蒂
大桶，与 butt 的桶义相近

entries.definition: the object aimed at, as in archery or mockery
entries.definitionCN: 靶子，引申为被攻击或嘲笑的对象

normalIntro.en: One short word, several thick ends: the ram's head, the cigarette's stub, the gun's stock.
normalIntro.cn: 一个短词，多种「粗端」：公羊的头、烟卷的蒂、枪的托。

normal.en: Butt heads means to clash directly.
normal.cn: butt heads 指正面冲突、顶牛。

normal.en: Butt in means to interrupt rudely.
A cigarette butt is the stub left after smoking.
normal.cn: cigarette butt 是抽剩的烟蒂。

normal.en: The butt of a joke takes the mockery.
normal.cn: the butt of a joke 指被取笑的对象。

normal.en: Abut keeps the same root in a mild form: to touch ends.
normal.cn: abut 保留同根的温和义：端部相接。

abstract.en: Feel the thud of a ram's head against your shield.
abstract.cn: 感受公羊头撞在盾上的闷响。

abstract.en: See smoke curl up from a crushed butt on the pavement.
abstract.cn: 看人行道上被踩灭的烟蒂冒出最后一缕烟。

abstract.en: Picture a rain barrel brimming under the eaves.
abstract.cn: 想象屋檐下接满雨水的大桶。

examples.en: The two rams butted heads until one gave way.
examples.cn: 两只公羊顶了半天脑袋，直到一方退让。

examples.en: Please don't butt in while adults are talking.
The old wine butt held more than a bathtub would.
examples.cn: 那只旧酒桶比浴缸装得还多。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「巴特」——小羊「巴不得」用脑袋「特」别使劲地顶你一下。

root: butt 的顶撞义源自日耳曼语「击打、推撞」词根，经古法语 boter 进入英语；「粗端、烟蒂」义与 button 同根，指承受撞击的一端；「大桶」义另出后期拉丁语 buttis，属同形异源。

sensesIntro.en: From a pushing head grow the blow, the thick end that takes blows, the mocked target, the cask by coincidence, and the seated end of the body.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一只顶撞的头部生出：那一撞、承受撞击的粗端、被嘲笑的靶子、因同形而并存的酒桶，以及身体的末端。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lowered head driving forward into a blow.
core.cn: 核心意象：低下的头向前猛地一顶。

branches.en: rams butt heads on the hillside

branches.cn: butt in，话语上的横插一杠

intro.en: Butt is short and sturdy like its meaning; its relatives keep the idea of pushing or of thick ends.
intro.cn: butt 短而结实，恰如其义；同族词都保有「推撞」或「粗端」之意。

latinIntro.en: The striking root passed from Germanic into French and back; the cask word is Late Latin buttis.
latinIntro.cn: 「击打」词根从日耳曼语进入法语再回流英语；「大桶」词另出后期拉丁语 buttis。

items.meaning: a structure that pushes against a wall
the rounded end of the body

items.example: drop the butt in the ashtray

items.meaning: the stock end of a gun

items.example: a water butt by the shed

items.meaning: the mound used as a target
